source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: As either [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase) ends, increase this model’s [Mechanical Augmentation](vsdata:ability/necrons.illuminor-szeras.mechanical-augmentation) range by 3″ if it destroyed at least one model that phase. The increase lasts through the battle, and the range caps at 12″.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
